text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to begin training with Mihono
Bourbon.
She usually finishes getting
ready well before
we're supposed to
start, but today's different.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...One minute left until training begins.
Thank you
for waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. You see—
choice_data_list: ギリギリなんて珍しいな
ギリギリなんて珍しいね

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: FOUND YA!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bourbon! Our discussion isn't over!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. However, it is already time for
my
training to begin. I am thus unable to
debate any
longer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's correct! The topic at hand is why
she keeps
breaking our vending
machines!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class representative, it is my
responsibility to
prevent the destruction
of school property!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Any machinery I come into contact with
breaks
down without exception. The
cause is unknown. It
is not done with
intention.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I know you don't mean to break them!
But there's
still room for discussion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O spreads her arms
wide as if to
prevent Mihono Bourbon
from running away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To be fair, it is pretty weird to be able to break machines just by touching them. An investigation may be worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But for now, the issue at hand is that the
vending
machines are out of service.
Maybe we need some
kind of
countermeasure.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Are you listening to me, Bourbon?! I
want to hear
your trainer's thoughts on
the issue too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh? Yes, you're right about that.
choice_data_list: 自販機が使えないのは困るなぁ

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer. I recognize the situation is
very
"inconvenient."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Vending machines are essential when
one cannot
refill their water bottle or
purchase a drink from
the store.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But... I cannot use them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can't let things continue like this. If
I'm with
her, it's fine, but if I'm not...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A friend... I have determined that option
to be
difficult.
choice_data_list: 近くにいる友だちに頼もう
道具を使って買うとか

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
First, there are very few people that I
can refer to
as friends.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Second, those few friends will not
necessarily be
nearby when—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then just call me over! No matter the
time, no
matter the place, I'll Bakushin
right to you in a
flash!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class representative, I can't abandon
a student
in need! And besides, we're
friends!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...We are?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course we are! Aren't you proud to
have the
class representative as a
friend?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Not particularly. But yes... we are
friends...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I can imagine how thrilled you
are about
that, but don't just stand there
repeating it.
You're gonna make me
blush.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will call for you when I
need to
use a vending machine,
Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just leave it to me, the perfect
role model
for all students—the class
representative, Sakura
Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...My friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From then on...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start to notice Mihono Bourbon near
vending
machines at times, restlessly
searching for her
friend, Sakura Bakushin
O.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A tool... perhaps something like tongs?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! You've got a good head on your
shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You can use them to put your money in
and all
that without actually touching
the machine! Let's
go try it out later!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will do as Trainer
commands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Mihono Bourbon tries using
tongs to
operate a vending machine.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uh, what's all this? Why're you using
tongs,
Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to buy some juice or
something? I'll
press the buttons for you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You don't need those tongs,
Bourbon. I'll
help you out—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... sorry. I can't reach the top button...
Can you
give me a boost?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Since then, people nearby always end
up helping
me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on this experience, I have
determined that
asking for help is more
efficient than using tongs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Despite my lack of communication skills,

someone will help me if I ask.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will be sure to record this in my
memory logs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Mihono Bourbon has plenty
of
friends willing to help her—she just
hadn't
realized it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, she knows just how important
it is to
rely on others.
